lines.say: In 1904, an Olympic runner won on fucking rat poison.
It was ninety degrees in St. Louis, and the boss wanted to study dehydration.
So twenty-four miles got one damn water stop.
One runner got chased a mile off course by a wild dog.
A Cuban mailman ran in street clothes, ate rotten apples, took a nap, and still finished fourth.
Another son of a bitch rode ten miles in a car, jogged in first, and got cheered.
The real winner was Tom Hicks. His own trainers dosed him with rat poison and brandy.
He finished hallucinating his ass off, had to be carried, and took the gold.
That runner got one water stop. Your regulars get zero check-ins.
caps: That runner got one water stop.
